sloka: ते तार्क्ष्य बल संपन्नाः सर्वे युद्ध विशारदाः ।विचरन्तोऽर्दयन् सर्वान् सिंह व्याघ्र महोरगान् ॥१-१७-३४॥
transliteration: te tārkṣya bala saṁpannāḥ sarve yuddha viśāradāḥ ।vicaranto'rdayan sarvān siṁha vyāghra mahoragān ॥1-17-34॥

translations.english: Born in many forms wih various characteristics (relating to the body and tribe), they pervaded this earth with its mountains, forests and seas.
